title: Our Body & Senses
description: Grade 2 Science: our body and five senses. Body parts, the sense organs, using our senses, and healthy clean habits — with a tap-the-part body game and more.

topics.title: Parts of Our Body
topics.concept:
Our body is made of many parts, and each one has a job:

  • 🧠 Head — holds our brain, which helps us think.
  • ✋ Hands — to hold, write and play.
  • 🦵 Legs — to walk, run and jump.
  • 🦶 Feet — we stand and balance on them.

Inside, our body has a heart that beats and lungs that help us breathe.

recap: Our body has many parts, each with a job.
Head thinks, hands hold, legs walk, feet help us stand.
Inside, the heart beats and lungs help us breathe.

wonder.text: Your body can run, hold, see and think — all at once! How many body parts can you name?

qa.a: The brain inside your head is the boss of your body! It helps you think, remember, learn and tells all your other parts what to do.

qa.q: Why can I bend my arms and legs?
qa.a: Your body has special bending places called joints — like your elbow and knee. They work like hinges so you can bend, run and play.

topics.title: Our Five Senses
topics.concept:
We learn about the world using our five senses. Each sense uses a special body part called a sense organ:

  • 👁️ Eyes — to see.
  • 👂 Ears — to hear.
  • 👃 Nose — to smell.
  • 👅 Tongue — to taste.
  • ✋ Skin — to touch and feel.

recap: We have five senses: see, hear, smell, taste, touch.
Sense organs: eyes, ears, nose, tongue, skin.
Each sense organ has its own special job.

wonder.text: Close your eyes. You can still hear, smell and touch. How does your body do that?

qa.q: How do I taste different flavours?
qa.a: Your tongue has tiny taste buds that tell you if food is sweet, salty, sour or bitter. That is how an orange tastes different from a lemon!
Your skin can feel if something is hot or cold, soft or hard, smooth or rough. It even warns you to pull away from something too hot!

topics.title: Using Our Senses
topics.concept:
We use our senses together all day long, often without even thinking:

  • 👁️ We see the colours of a rainbow.
  • 👂 We hear music and a friend's voice.
  • 👃 We smell tasty food and flowers.
  • 👅 We taste sweet, sour and salty food.
  • ✋ We feel a soft cat and warm sunshine.

Our senses also keep us safe — they warn us of fire, bad smells and loud dangers.

recap: We use our senses together all day.
Senses let us enjoy colours, sounds, smells and tastes.
Senses also keep us safe from danger.

wonder.text: How do you know an ice cream is cold, sweet and smells nice — all before your first lick?

qa.q: How do senses keep me safe?
qa.a: Your nose smells smoke to warn of fire, your ears hear a horn so you move away, and your skin feels something too hot. Senses protect you!

qa.q: Do we use more than one sense at a time?
qa.a: Yes! When you eat a mango, you see it, smell it, feel it and taste it all together. Your senses are a wonderful team.

topics.title: Keeping Our Body Clean
topics.concept:
Keeping clean keeps tiny germs away and keeps us healthy:

  • 🧼 Wash hands with soap before eating and after the toilet.
  • 🚿 Take a bath every day.
  • 🪥 Brush teeth twice a day, morning and night.
  • ✂️ Keep nails short and clean.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eefcff"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🧼</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Wash hands</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🪥</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Brush</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🚿</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Bath</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Keeping clean</text></svg>
recap: Wash hands with soap, bathe daily, brush twice a day.

wonder.text: Tiny germs we cannot even see can make us ill. How do we keep them away?

qa.q: Why must I wash my hands before eating?
qa.a: Our hands touch many things and pick up tiny germs we cannot see. Washing with soap removes the germs so they do not go into our tummy and make us ill.

qa.q: Why brush teeth twice a day?
qa.a: Brushing removes bits of food and germs that can cause holes (cavities) in our teeth. Morning and night brushing keeps our teeth strong and our smile bright!

topics.title: Healthy Habits
topics.concept:
Good habits help our body grow healthy and strong:

  • 🥗 Eat healthy food — fruits, vegetables, milk and grains.
  • 💧 Drink plenty of water.
  • 🏃 Play and exercise every day.
  • 😴 Get enough sleep at night.
  • 🍬 Eat sweets and watch screens only a little.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eefff2"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥗</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Eat well</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🏃</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Play</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">😴</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Sleep</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Healthy habits</text></svg>
recap: Eat healthy food and drink lots of water.
Play, exercise and sleep well every day.
Have sweets and screens only a little.

wonder.text: What helps your body grow strong — sweets and screens, or fruits and play?

qa.a: While you sleep, your body rests, grows and gets ready for the next day. Good sleep helps you feel happy, learn well and stay healthy.
A few sweets are okay as a treat, but too many can harm your teeth and tummy. Fruits are nature's sweet treat — and they are good for you!

questions.explanation: The brain in our head helps us think and learn.
Our ears are the sense organ for hearing.

questions.q: Which sense organ helps us taste?
questions.explanation: Our tongue has taste buds that help us taste food.

questions.q: How many senses do we have?
questions.explanation: We have five senses: see, hear, smell, taste and touch.
Washing hands with soap keeps germs away.
Brush teeth twice a day, morning and night.

questions.q: Which sense organ warns us of a fire by its smell?
questions.explanation: The nose smells smoke and warns us of fire.

questions.q: When you eat a mango, which senses do you use?
options: See, smell, touch and taste together
questions.explanation: You see, smell, feel and taste the mango — your senses work as a team.

questions.q: Tiny taste buds that help us taste are on the…
questions.explanation: Taste buds on the tongue tell us if food is sweet, salty or sour.

questions.q: Why should we wash hands before eating?
options: To remove tiny germs we cannot see
questions.explanation: Hands pick up germs we cannot see; soap washes them away so we stay healthy.

questions.q: Which set is ALL healthy habits?
options: Brush teeth, eat fruit, sleep well
Eat sweets, skip bath, watch TV all day
Skip sleep, eat chips, no exercise
questions.explanation: Brushing teeth, eating fruit and sleeping well are all healthy habits.
